summary.text: Tony De Mille is the Utah Forward Party candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Jeffrey Anderson (D) and Erik Craythorne (R).
A realtor, he describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a husband, father and grandfather who is not a career politician.

paragraphs.text: Tony De Mille graduated from Viewmont High School and works as a realtor.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has spent years involved in local community activities and volunteering.
He named three campaign themes: putting people over politics, making decisions based on data, and accountability and transparency from elected officials, agencies and law enforcement.
He also said he supports strong public education and responsible stewardship of resources.
